name: Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the state of play of advancing EU-Africa trade and investment relations
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its views on trade and investment between the EU and Africa. It is not a law and changes nothing by itself. It calls for more EU money and support for African infrastructure, clean energy, digital skills and local processing of raw materials. It wants fairer deals, more say for Parliament, and stronger safeguards on pesticides, mining and debt. It also urges the EU to speak with one voice against growing Chinese and Russian influence.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; Parliament only asks the EU Commission to act.
- **Who it affects:** African and EU businesses, workers, farmers, investors and governments.
- **What happens next:** The Commission decides whether to follow these requests.
